blind.description: A single modular interior wall section. The front face features cream-coloured lower wainscoting with three recessed panels, dark green patterned damask wallpaper, a central framed window with six small glass panes and a projecting sill, and a prominent decorative cornice at the top. The reverse side features matching lower wainscot paneling and full-height green patterned wallpaper up to the top molding, with no window aperture. The structure is clean, solid, and fully textured in a stylized architectural finish.
blind.from_above: A simple narrow beige rectangle corresponding to the top edge of the projecting crown molding, casting a long diagonal shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 6 ft tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 3.5 ft wide.
